title: Current Openings
description:
Thank you for your interest in joining our team. At present, we do not have any open positions at Black Talon. However, as we continue to grow and evolve in our mission to protect companies of all sizes from cyberthreats, new opportunities are continually in the works. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals who can bring something unique to our team.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future vacancies and appreciate your interest in Black Talon. You may submit your information to be considered for future roles as they become available.

Submit Resume

Please mention the word **OUTPERFORMED** and tag RMTQ1LjEzMi45OS4xMDI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTQ1LjEzMi45OS4xMDI=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
